build_model_sparse_rcnn: build a SparseRCNN model with ResNet50 backbone and FPN neck for COCO object detection
configure_roi_head: configure SparseRoIHead with 6 stages, DIIHead bbox heads, and HungarianAssigner for training
setup_optimizer: setup AdamW optimizer with learning rate 0.000025 and gradient clipping max norm 1
define_loss_functions: define FocalLoss classification, L1Loss bounding box, and GIoULoss IoU losses for detection training
configure_data_preprocessor: configure DetDataPreprocessor with ImageNet mean/std normalization and 32-pixel pad size divisor
